entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand I bought. It's absolutely useless.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF88602. And don't give me the runaround. This thing is so incredibly hard to use, it's a joke.
Okay, I'm pulling up order VF88602 now. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with how it functions?

Are you listening? It's confusing! I expected more from a premium product. I even wasted my time reading the user manual and it didn't help at all. I want my money back, and I want it back now. Get me your manager if you can't do it.
There's no need for that, sir. I can handle this for you. I just need to confirm a few details. Let me just check the return policy against your delivery date. One moment please.
You'd better. I'm one click away from leaving a review that will make sure no one ever buys from VeloFit again.

Okay, I've confirmed everything. I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor was delivered 14 days ago, on January 5th. According to our policy, you have 10 days to make a return. You're unfortunately outside that timeframe, so I cannot approve this return for a full refund immediately.
See? That's all you had to do. Don't know why you had to make it so difficult. Send me the return label.

Of course. I've just emailed the prepaid return label to the address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
